item: 4. ARCANet as a zero-measurement deep comparator
decision: Whether a deep dose-response model that reads only the drug reaches useful accuracy on this screen, and where it stands against structural read-across and against three measured concentrations.
comparator: ARCANet, Alonso Campana, Prasse & Scheffer, ICML 2024, 'Predicting Dose-Response Curves with Deep Neural Networks'; github.com/alonsocampana/ARCANet (MIT).
feasibility_judgement: Adaptable within a day and therefore run. The published model multiplies a drug embedding by a cell-line transcriptome and reads one viability per concentration, without any measurement of the same drug in the same cell line. This screen has a single biological system and no transcriptome, so the drug branch (GATRes: GATv2 layers over the molecular graph) and the LatentHillFusionModule over log concentration are imported from the authors' file unchanged, the cell-line branch is dropped, and the linear head widens from 1 to 68 outputs. Pooling uses torch-geometric's AttentionalAggregation, the current name of the GlobalAttention layer their GatedAttnPooling is built on, with the same gate and value networks; their variant adds the cell-line node set before pooling, which here would be zero.
training: Authors' optimizer and scheduler: Adam with ReduceLROnPlateau (factor 0.5, patience 4) on the training loss, batch 32 chemicals, targets are the measured concentration-level means with the screen's masks. Three seeds (0, 1, 2) per fold and the arithmetic mean of their predictions, the convention of the published neural-process comparison. Training chemicals are those whose fold differs from the test fold.
selection: Loss (their MSE or L1), model size (their sizes or a smaller variant) and the epoch budget are chosen once on the development partition (fold 0, trained on folds 1-4) by zero-measurement target MAE, then frozen.
structures: The same EPA CompTox batch-search SMILES as item 2. A chemical without a SMILES, or whose graph has no bond (inorganic salts and single-atom species), cannot enter a graph model; those chemicals are named in the report.
scoring: Zero measurements, scored on the same held-out cells as the three-point designs of Fig. 2, with release/chip_forecast.py's curve MAE; an offset variant and a 0.75 interpolation blend show what the three measured concentrations add, mirroring item 2.
endpoints: Zero-measurement MAE with paired chemical-level differences against GenRA, interpolation, AnchorBoost and the CNP (10,000 resamples, seed 0, 95%)

expected_before_run.arcanet_zero_mae: 1.4 to 1.9, that is at or above GenRA's zero-measurement error and far above AnchorBoost
expected_before_run.versus_genra: -0.2 to +0.2; a graph network trained on 180-odd chemicals may or may not beat a similarity-weighted neighbour average
expected_before_run.if_the_comparator_wins: report it as the headline of this item

verification: verify_arcanet.py recomputes the ensemble means and every interval from the saved per-design tables through a separate code path.
